game.name: Human Fall Flat
game.rules:
## General

- Loading circle must always be visible in video for runs to be valid.
- Using the Infinite Fly Glitch is not allowed.
- Spawn displacement is not allowed, as it is hardware restrictive. Very slow load times are required to get it.
- Downpatching your game version is not allowed for any platform, you must play on the latest version provided by your platform.
- Console commands are not allowed (this includes ClimbCheat and ThrowCheat).
- Your submission video has to start in either the main menu, level select or from the previous level ; ONLY co-op runs are allowed to start in the multiplayer lobby.

## PC

- It is required to use the autosplitter for game time, and it must be visible in the video for it to be valid.
- For runs without the autosplitter your game time will be set to match your real time.
- A player developed an in-game timer called "plcc's timer" which is more accurate than livesplit (for bad computers). You can use livesplit or plcc's timer as your autosplitter. The file is uploaded in the resource section with its documentation. You are allowed to use the One-Key Retry (which automatically restarts your level) and the checkpoint% mode.

## Console

- You do not need a timer, but it can be nice for personal use to see what pace you are on.
- We will retime your run accurately manually, but atleast try to post a semi-accurate time when submitting.
- As of late November 2020 we now try to manually subtract load times for console runs.

## Coop

- Runs must be submitted with the host's game- and real-time.
- If a player crashes/disconnects in a run, you must wait for said player to rejoin the game before continuing the run; the timer will not be paused while waiting for the returning player.
- If a player joins during the run, you need to take him into account on speedrun.com. If you were 2 players when starting the run, this will bring you to the 3p+ subcategory.
- Runs must be submitted with at least the host's POV. 
We need a video for every player that triggers an end-zone.
Multiple video links work, just separate video links with a semicolon and space (";" and " ").

## [Click here for Definitions of Glitches/Exploits](https://www.speedrun.com/hff/thread/c2qq6)

- If a player crashes/disconnects in a run, you must wait for said player to rejoin the game before continuing the run; the timer will not be paused while waiting for the returning player.

categories.rules:
## Look at the **Game Rules** tab for rules that span every category

## General

- Time starts when first loading into Mansion from the Main Menu/Level select.
- Time ends when the loading circle in the top right appears after completing Aztec, loading into Dark.

## Solo

- You must complete every level in sequential order, without returning to the Main Menu.
- You are not allowed to use the pinch glitch

## Solo No Extended Climb

- You must complete every level in sequential order, without returning to the Main Menu.
- You are not allowed to do Extended Climb (for a definition of extended climbing check the link at the bottom).
- You are not allowed to use the pinch glitch

## Solo Glitchless

- You must complete every level in sequential order, without returning to the Main Menu.
- You are not allowed to do the following: Pinch, Speedglitch, Footsie, Item hover (prop fly), catapult boost

## Solo Pinch

- You must complete every level in sequential order, without returning to the Main Menu.
- The only solo category where pinch is allowed

## Coop 2p & 3p+

- You must complete every level in sequential order, without returning to the Multiplayer lobby.
- Follow the player limits for the category
- You are not allowed to use the pinch glitch

## Coop No Extended Climb

- You must complete every level in sequential order, without returning to the Multiplayer lobby.
- You are not allowed to do Extended Climb (for a definition of extended climbing check the link at the bottom).
- You are not allowed to use the pinch glitch

## Coop 2p & 3p+ Glitchless

- You must complete every level in sequential order, without returning to the Multiplayer lobby.
- Follow the player limits for the category
- You are not allowed to do the following: Pinch, Speedglitch, Footsie, Item hover (prop fly), catapult boost

## Coop 2p & 3p+ Pinch

- You must complete every level in sequential order, without returning to the Multiplayer lobby.
- Follow the player limits for the category

levels.name: Mansion
levels.rules:
## Look at the __Game Rules__ tab for rules that span every category

Timer starts when first loading into the level from Main Menu.

To clarify, this means you have to start the level either from the Main Menu's "New Game" or "Level Select".

The level "Reprise" is an exception to the above; you may access it via console using "l 12 0", but the console must be visible in the video. You must "Exit to Main Menu" at the end of each "Reprise" attempt before you input this console command.

"Restart Level" does not count, as this simply takes you back to checkpoint 0 and breaks certain levels (i.e. Dark's last few checkpoints).

Timer ends when the loading circle appears at the end of the level, indicating you are loading the next level.

Spawn Displacement is not allowed.

For game time to be valid, it is required to use the Autosplitter found in Resources or LiveSplit.

## General

- Time starts when first loading into Mansion from the Main Menu/Level select.
- Time ends when the loading circle in the top right appears after completing Aztec, loading into Dark.

## Solo

- You must complete every level in sequential order, without returning to the Main Menu.
- You are not allowed to use the pinch glitch

- You must complete every level in sequential order, without returning to the Main Menu.
- You are not allowed to do Extended Climb (for a definition of extended climbing check the link at the bottom).
- You are not allowed to use the pinch glitch

## Solo Glitchless

- You must complete every level in sequential order, without returning to the Main Menu.
- You are not allowed to do the following: Pinch, Speedglitch, Footsie, Item hover (prop fly), catapult boost

## Solo Pinch

- You must complete every level in sequential order, without returning to the Main Menu.
- The only solo category where pinch is allowed

## Coop 2p & 3p+

- You must complete every level in sequential order, without returning to the Multiplayer lobby.
- Follow the player limits for the category
- You are not allowed to use the pinch glitch

- You must complete every level in sequential order, without returning to the Multiplayer lobby.
- You are not allowed to do Extended Climb (for a definition of extended climbing check the link at the bottom).
- You are not allowed to use the pinch glitch

- You must complete every level in sequential order, without returning to the Multiplayer lobby.
- Follow the player limits for the category
- You are not allowed to do the following: Pinch, Speedglitch, Footsie, Item hover (prop fly), catapult boost

## Coop 2p & 3p+ Pinch

- You must complete every level in sequential order, without returning to the Multiplayer lobby.
- Follow the player limits for the category

games.name: Human Fall Flat
games.rules:
## General

- Loading circle must always be visible in video for runs to be valid.
- Using the Infinite Fly Glitch is not allowed.
- Spawn displacement is not allowed, as it is hardware restrictive. Very slow load times are required to get it.
- Downpatching your game version is not allowed for any platform, you must play on the latest version provided by your platform.
- Console commands are not allowed (this includes ClimbCheat and ThrowCheat).
- Your submission video has to start in either the main menu, level select or from the previous level ; ONLY co-op runs are allowed to start in the multiplayer lobby.

## PC

- It is required to use the autosplitter for game time, and it must be visible in the video for it to be valid.
- For runs without the autosplitter your game time will be set to match your real time.
- A player developed an in-game timer called "plcc's timer" which is more accurate than livesplit (for bad computers). You can use livesplit or plcc's timer as your autosplitter. The file is uploaded in the resource section with its documentation. You are allowed to use the One-Key Retry (which automatically restarts your level) and the checkpoint% mode.

## Console

- You do not need a timer, but it can be nice for personal use to see what pace you are on.
- We will retime your run accurately manually, but atleast try to post a semi-accurate time when submitting.
- As of late November 2020 we now try to manually subtract load times for console runs.

## Coop

- Runs must be submitted with the host's game- and real-time.
- If a player crashes/disconnects in a run, you must wait for said player to rejoin the game before continuing the run; the timer will not be paused while waiting for the returning player.
- If a player joins during the run, you need to take him into account on speedrun.com. If you were 2 players when starting the run, this will bring you to the 3p+ subcategory.
- Runs must be submitted with at least the host's POV. 
We need a video for every player that triggers an end-zone.
Multiple video links work, just separate video links with a semicolon and space (";" and " ").

## [Click here for Definitions of Glitches/Exploits](https://www.speedrun.com/hff/thread/c2qq6)
